name: Email a weekday Grants.gov opportunity digest

parameters.content:
### How it works

Each weekday at 07:00 (or when you click Test workflow) this workflow reads your keyword, agency, lookback, item cap, closing-soon window and digest address from Set digest options. It calls the official Public Records Grants.gov Actor on your own Apify account, waits for the dataset, and normalizes the rows. Opportunity numbers already emailed are skipped (kept in this workflow's static data). Remaining grants are ranked by close date, soon-to-close rows are flagged, and one HTML digest is sent through Gmail. If the Apify request fails, a separate branch emails a failure alert to the same address. If nothing new remains after filters and dedupe, the run ends without an empty email.

### Setup

1. Create an HTTP Header Auth credential: header name `Authorization`, value `Bearer` plus your Apify API token from Apify Console → Settings → API & Integrations. Assign that credential to Fetch open grants from Grants.gov.
2. Connect a Gmail account to Send grant digest email and Send failure alert.
3. In Set digest options, replace `YOUR_EMAIL@example.com` with your address. Set `keyword` (or leave it blank for all opportunities), `agency` (for example NSF or HHS), `status` (`posted` or `forecasted|posted`), `postedWithinDays`, `maxItems`, `closingSoonDays` and `dedupeMemoryDays`.
4. Click Test workflow once, confirm the email, then set the workflow to Active. The Actor is pay-per-use on your Apify account; check the Store listing for current pricing before you leave a schedule running.

### Customization

Change the weekday schedule, swap Gmail for Outlook, Slack or Microsoft Teams, or append the `grants` array from the filter node to Google Sheets. Clear this workflow's static data to reset dedupe history. You can turn on `fetchDetails` in the Actor body when you also map any extra synopsis fields in the filter node.

## Start and configure

Edit keyword, agency, lookback, item cap, closing-soon window and digest email here. Both triggers share this node. Later steps only read these placeholders.

## Fetch from Grants.gov

Sends your Config values as Actor input using Header Auth on your Apify account. The sync endpoint waits for the run and returns dataset rows. Failures take the error output.

## Filter, rank, and dedupe

Normalizes Actor rows, skips opportunity numbers already emailed, ranks by close date, and builds digest fields. An empty result stops without sending mail.

## Send the digest or an alert

New matches go out as one HTML email. Apify errors send a failure alert to the same Config address. Empty runs follow the no-op path.

nodes.name: Send the digest or an alert

parameters.content: Connect your Gmail credential and replace `YOUR_EMAIL@example.com` in Set digest options before you activate this workflow. The placeholder address is not a mailbox. Apify runs bill to your own account.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ keyword: $json.keyword, agency: $json.agency, status: $json.status, postedWithinDays: $json.postedWithinDays, maxItems: $json.maxItems, fetchDetails: $json.fetchDetails }) }}
